messages:
sanjay: Quick kickoff - NimbusEdge asked for a small marketplace-ready refarch + Terraform module + sample app. Target GA in ~3 weeks. Who takes module, sample, CI, and security checklist?

anya: I9ll own the TF module and variable schema. Need sec input on KMS, private registry, and VPC peering.

leo: I'll do the sample app (tiny Python + curl) and README. Prefer container image with a one-click deploy.

mira: I'll own CI/publish. Will add multi-arch builds (x86 + arm) and publish to staging registry.

sanjay: Partner called out Ampere compatibility and a minimal SBOM. @build_bot please create a staging repo and grant NimbusEdge push perms.

build_bot: Created repo nimbusedge-marketplace-staging and invited Nim (NimbusEdge). :white_check_mark:

Nim (NimbusEdge): Confirmed access. We can provide model artifacts and a small constraints doc. Will upload to the drive.

anya: Module API: vpc_id, subnets, instance_profile, model_bucket. Outputs: endpoint, alb_host, subnets. Keep it minimal.

leo: Sample app modes: local private endpoint and hosted-Fallback to Redwood API. Include quickstart for both.

mira: Timeline: wk0 scaffold + CI; wk1 sample + multi-arch images; wk2 partner review + security audit; wk3 finalize package + SBOM.

sanjay: Volunteers: @anya @leo @mira. Weekly sync Fri 10am PT. Tag infra-eng if blocked with marketplace-onramp.

anya: I'll scaffold repo and add semver + CHANGELOG by Tue.

leo: README skeleton and sample app prototype by Thu.

mira: CI pipeline and publish flow by Wed (includes ARM builds).

Nim (NimbusEdge): Uploading constraint doc now, will ping when live.

sanjay: Great. Add a minimal e2e smoke test that hits /health and runs 1 token infer to satisfy marketplace QA.
